title: Checkout failing with 5xx, p99 latency above 30s
alert: PagerDuty: checkout-api error rate 38% (threshold 2%) and p99 latency 31.4s (threshold 2s) for 6 minutes. Upstream: payment-service. Customer support reports card payments spinning then failing.

updates.text: Checkout failures are spreading to the mobile app; the support queue doubled in the last 5 minutes.
